title: Restriction to an open preserves K-injective complexes
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open inclusion. For a complex $I^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] that is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], the termwise restriction $j^{-1}I^\bullet$ is K-injective as a complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules.

source.place: Lemma lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open (Tag 08BS), using the exact left adjoint extension by zero

proof.text: For the open subspace $U\subseteq X$, the restriction functor on sheaves of modules is exact and has the exact left adjoint $j_!$ (extension by zero), by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. Thus, with $u=j^{-1}$ and $v=j_!$, the hypotheses of the right-adjoint K-injective preservation lemma are satisfied: $u$ is right adjoint to $v$ and $v$ is exact.

source.place: Lemma lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open (Tag 08BS), first sentence of the proof

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] to the abelian module categories on $X$ and $U$, with $u=j^{-1}$ and $v=j_!$. For the given K-injective complex $I^\bullet$, the termwise image $u(I^\bullet)=j^{-1}I^\bullet$ is K-injective on $U$, which is the asserted conclusion.
